facts.F1: Story 6601: Linux standalone builds no longer break when GitHub retires a runner image. The AppImage is built on a GitHub-hosted Ubuntu image with WebKitGTK pinned to that image's package version; when ubuntu-latest moved to 26.04 the pins vanished and the release was blocked; the quick fix pins runs-on: ubuntu-24.04, which breaks again when GitHub retires 24.04. Building on a newer image raises the glibc the AppImage needs and stops it starting on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and Debian 13. Goal: the Linux build no longer depends on which runner images GitHub offers; the minimum glibc and distribution is a written decision changed on purpose. Acceptance: (1) the Linux standalone builds without naming a GitHub runner image that will be retired, or there is a documented, alarmed path for when it is; (2) the minimum glibc and distribution is written down and CI fails if a build exceeds it; (3) the AppImage still starts on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.
facts.F2: Releases are never blocked by GitHub retiring a runner image, and Linux users on the supported distributions keep a working app
facts.F3: The Linux standalone release builds without naming a GitHub runner image that GitHub will retire, or a retirement is announced by an alarm before it blocks a release
facts.F4: The minimum glibc and distribution for the Linux AppImage is a written decision, and CI fails a build whose AppImage needs a newer glibc than that floor
facts.F5: The AppImage still starts on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
facts.F6: Raising or lowering the supported Linux floor itself: today's floor (the glibc of Ubuntu 24.04) is written down as it is, not changed
facts.F7: Moving the macOS and Windows packaging off macos-latest and windows-latest; DESIGN only notes their exposure
facts.F8: A Linux packaging run fails, naming the binary and the GLIBC version, when the AppImage needs a newer glibc than the written floor, and passes on today's build
facts.F9: The Linux AppImage is built on a build environment whose glibc we choose, on a runner GitHub will not retire, still passes the floor check and still starts on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
